players.name: Jeremiah Smith
players.note: 6 catches, 165 yards, 2 TDs (incl. 67-yarder on the opening drive) in the Nov. 21 31-28 upset loss at Nebraska, which ended Ohio State's title hopes; a late deep INT was thrown his way. Prior: 11-117-1 vs Northwestern (Nov. 14). Consensus 1.01 in DLF/Dynasty Nerds/Rotoballer SF mocks.

players.name: Drew Mestemaker
players.note: Threw for 277 yards, 1 TD, 2 INTs in the Nov. 14 52-27 loss to Texas Tech; listed questionable with a stinger before the Nov. 21 game at Arizona State, and that result/his status was not confirmed in sources. Still a top-3 SF pick in DraftSharks and Rotoballer (1.02).

players.name: Darian Mensah
players.note: 382 yards and 1 TD in the Nov. 14 36-25 win over Duke (AP). Nov. 21 home game vs Virginia Tech: final score not confirmed (sources conflict); Miami closing on an ACC title-game berth.

players.name: CJ Carr
players.note: 217 yards, 2 TDs in the Nov. 14 41-7 win over Boston College. A Week 12 scoreboard lists Notre Dame 24-3 over SMU on Nov. 21, but no recap or Carr stat line was confirmed. Footballguys has warned he could return to school.

players.name: Trinidad Chambliss
players.note: Senior, so certain to be in the 2027 class; DLF's Nov. 13 SF mock says he could push for round 1 of the NFL draft. Kiper's QB3 (Oct. 30). No November game lines confirmed in sources.

players.name: Jadan Baugh
players.note: No November stat line confirmed (Florida beat Kentucky 21-14 on Nov. 14). Was DLF's 1.09 in September and 1.02 in a Dynasty Nerds SF mock; PFF had him at 438 rush yards, 8 TDs through three games.

players.name: Arch Manning
players.note: Rallied Texas past LSU 22-21 on Nov. 14 despite 3 INTs. Texas reportedly handled Arkansas on Nov. 21 (score/line not confirmed). Footballguys (v5-v6) and Yahoo flag a likely return to school or transfer; Tankathon dropped him from its 2027 mock.

players.name: Dante Moore
players.note: Out for the season after the September concussion (Lanning, Oct. 26); Yahoo calls his 2027 draft status unclear. No new info found through Nov. 23.

players.name: Charlie Becker
players.note: Had 11 catches, 224 yards and 2 TDs over the Nov. 7-14 games and 10 TD catches on the season (AP preview, Nov. 19). A Yahoo Week 12 headline says Washington toppled Indiana on Nov. 21; his line in that game is not confirmed. DraftSharks (undated) has him No. 2 in SF.

players.name: Ryan Coleman-Williams
players.note: Ranked WR3 by Matt Miller; drops remain a concern. No November stat line confirmed in sources.

players.name: KJ Duff
players.note: Moves up: DLF's Nov. 13 SF rookie mock took him at 1.09. Had 45-774-9 heading into the Michigan game; no November line confirmed.

players.name: Cam Coleman
players.note: Left the Oct. 31 Mississippi State win early for the second straight game with no disclosed injury; no November stat line (including the Nov. 21 Arkansas game) confirmed.

players.name: Julian Sayin
players.note: Still sidelined by the throwing-elbow injury; freshman Luke Fahey started again in the Nov. 21 loss at Nebraska. Tankathon projects a return to school.

players.name: Trey'Dez Green
players.note: Returned from his knee injury with 5-50-1 at Auburn. LSU reportedly lost 27-13 at Tennessee on Nov. 21 (single scoreboard source); his line not confirmed.

players.name: Isaac Brown
players.note: Top-five RB on Matt Miller's list and 18th in DraftSharks' SF rankings. No November update found.

players.name: Mark Fletcher Jr.
players.note: Senior power back; co-starred with Mensah in the 41-13 win at Clemson. No November stat line confirmed.

players.name: Austin Simmons
players.note: ESPN's Thamel reported Nov. 6 that Missouri re-signed him for 2027, the strongest sign he stays. Missouri beat Kentucky 28-14 on Nov. 21 (CBS); his line not confirmed.

players.name: Kewan Lacy
players.note: Dislocated his shoulder Oct. 24 at Texas, his third 2026 injury; return status still not confirmed in sources as of Nov. 23.

players.name: Bryant Wesco Jr.
players.note: 1,245 career yards; slow 2026 start (16-163 through late September). No November update found.

players.name: John Mateer
players.note: Led the Oct. 10 Red River win, then on the injury report. Oklahoma beat Texas A&M 28-7 on Nov. 21; whether Mateer played or his line was not confirmed.

players.name: LaNorris Sellers
players.note: Stock down in CBS's October NFL-scout QB survey. A Week 12 scoreboard lists Georgia 34-6 over South Carolina on Nov. 21; his line not confirmed.

players.name: Nate Frazier
players.note: Played through injured ribs (Footballguys, Oct. 21). Georgia won at South Carolina on Nov. 21; his line not confirmed.

players.name: Ryan Wingo
players.note: Led Texas with 834 yards in 2025 and opened 2026 with a 7-121-1 game.

players.name: TJ Moore
players.note: 837-yard 2025 producer ranked 19th by DraftSharks; Clemson's offense managed just 13 points against Miami on Oct. 3.

players.name: Jayden Maiava
players.note: 311 yards in USC's 27-13 loss at Indiana (Nov. 14); DraftSharks names him a possible first-round riser. QB6 on B/R's board.

players.name: Ahmad Hardy
players.note: Had not returned from offseason gunshot-wound rehab as of Footballguys' Oct. 21 board; no newer status confirmed.

players.name: Sam Leavitt
players.note: PFF Week 1 riser in Kiffin's LSU offense; DraftSharks lists him as a possible first-round riser. LSU reportedly lost 27-13 at Tennessee on Nov. 21; line not confirmed.

players.name: Nyck Harbor
players.note: Size-speed WR4 for NFL Draft Bible; PFF Week 5 stock report. South Carolina reportedly lost 34-6 to Georgia on Nov. 21; line not confirmed.

players.name: Justice Haynes
players.note: Senior back in Brugler's top five RBs. Michigan reportedly edged UCLA 18-16 on Nov. 21 (Yahoo scoreboard); his line not confirmed.

players.name: Duce Robinson
players.note: Big-bodied receiver in NFL Draft Bible's WR top five and Roto Street Journal's superflex mock.

players.name: Luke Reynolds
players.note: PFF Week 8 stock riser at tight end, moving up from Walter Football's TE6 slot.

players.name: Jamari Johnson
players.note: Falls after PFF named him a Week 6 stock-down tight end, though CBS and ESPN still rate him a top inline TE.

players.name: Raleek Brown
players.note: Caught Manning's game-winning 4-yard TD with about 3 seconds left in Texas' 22-21 win at LSU on Nov. 14; on Matt Miller's top-five RB list.

players.name: Reed Harris
players.note: Contested-catch transfer flagged as a PFF stock riser in 2026.

players.name: Terrance Carter Jr.
players.note: Productive but undersized (6-2, 245) tight end ranked TE3-TE5 by most boards.

players.name: Peter Clarke
players.note: Led all FBS tight ends with a 90.5 PFF grade in 2025; TE4 on PFF and ESPN lists.

players.name: Caleb Odom
players.note: Big receiving tight end who appears on DraftSharks' 2027 board.

players.name: Jeremiah Hasley
players.note: Walter Football's TE7 in its September 2026 update.

players.name: Decker DeGraaf
players.note: Appears in ESPN analysts' top-five 2027 tight ends.

players.name: DJ Vonnahme
players.note: Appears in ESPN analysts' top-five 2027 tight ends.

players.name: Drake Lindsey
players.note: NFL personnel staffers labeled him stock down in CBS's October survey of the 2027 QB class.
